dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Many of our tribespeople love music and dance, and have an amazing sense of rhythm.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: In the past, outlanders have come here just to study our culture and exchange views.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: My parents wanted me to learn dance, but I wanted to become a warrior instead!
